\newcommand{\erase}[1]{}


\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\newtheorem{proposition}[theorem]{Proposition}
\newtheorem{corollary}[theorem]{Corollary}



\newtheorem{_algorithm}[theorem]{Algorithm}
\newenvironment{algorithm}{\begin{_algorithm}\rm}{\hfill \rule{3pt}{6pt}\end{_algorithm}}


\newtheorem{_definition}[theorem]{Definition}
\newenvironment{definition}{\begin{_definition}\rm}{\end{_definition}}

\newtheorem{_propositiondefinition}[theorem]{Proposition-Definition}
\newenvironment{propositiondefinition}{\begin{_propositiondefinition}\rm}{\end{_propositiondefinition}}


\newtheorem{_remark}[theorem]{\it Remark}
\newenvironment{remark}{\begin{_remark}\rm}{\end{_remark}}

\newtheorem{_example}[theorem]{Example}
\newenvironment{example}{\begin{_example}\rm}{\end{_example}}

\newtheorem{_assumption}[theorem]{Assumption}
\newenvironment{assumption}{\begin{_assumption}\rm}{\end{_assumption}}

\newtheorem{_construction}[theorem]{Construction}
\newenvironment{construction}{\begin{_construction}\rm}{\end{_construction}}

\newtheorem{_claim}[theorem]{Claim}
\newenvironment{claim}{\begin{_claim}\rm}{\end{_claim}}


\newtheorem{_conjecture}[theorem]{Conjecture}
\newenvironment{conjecture}{\begin{_conjecture}\rm}{\end{_conjecture}}



\numberwithin{equation}{section}
\numberwithin{table}{section}
\numberwithin{figure}{section}
\renewcommand{\qed}{\hfill {$\Box$}}

%ARROWS



\newcommand{\congsb}[1]{\smash{\mathop{\cong}\limits\sb{#1}}}

\newcommand{\maprightsp}[1]{\; \smash{\mathop{\; \longrightarrow \; }\limits\sp{#1}}\; }
\newcommand{\maprightsb}[1]{\; \smash{\mathop{\; \longrightarrow \; }\limits\sb{#1}}\; }
\newcommand{\maprightspsb}[2]{\; \smash{\mathop{\; \longrightarrow \; }\limits\sp{#1}\limits\sb{#2}}\; }

\newcommand{\mapleftsp}[1]{\; \smash{\mathop{\; \longleftarrow \; }\limits\sp{#1}}\; }
\newcommand{\mapleftsb}[1]{\; \smash{\mathop{\; \longleftarrow \; }\limits\sb{#1}}\; }
\newcommand{\mapleftspsb}[2]{\; \smash{\mathop{\; \longleftarrow \; }\limits\sp{#1}\limits\sb{#2}}\; }


\newcommand{\mapshortrightsp}[1]{\smash{\mathop{\to}\limits\sp{#1}}}
\newcommand{\mapshortrightsb}[1]{\smash{\mathop{\to}\limits\sb{#1}}}
\newcommand{\mapshortrightspsb}[2]{\smash{\mathop{\to}\limits\sp{#1}\limits\sb{#2} }}

\newcommand{\maprightinj}{\; \smash{\mathop{\; \inj \; }}\; }
\newcommand{\maprightinjsp}[1]{\; \smash{\mathop{\; \inj \; }\limits\sp{#1}}\; }
\newcommand{\maprightinjsb}[1]{\; \smash{\mathop{\; \inj\; }\limits\sb{#1}}\; }

\newcommand{\maprightsurj}{\; \smash{\mathop{\; \surj \; }}\; }
\newcommand{\maprightsurjsp}[1]{\; \smash{\mathop{\; \surj \; }\limits\sp{#1}}\; }
\newcommand{\maprightsurjsb}[1]{\; \smash{\mathop{\; \surj\; }\limits\sb{#1}}\; }


\newcommand{\maprightisom}{\; \smash{\mathop{\; \longrightarrow \; }\limits\sp{\sim}}\; }
\newcommand{\maprightisomsb}[1]{\; \smash{\mathop{\; \longrightarrow \; }\limits\sp{\sim}\limits\sb{#1}}\; }
\newcommand{\mapleftisom}{\; \smash{\mathop{\; \longleftarrow \; }\limits\sp{\sim}}\; }
\newcommand{\mapleftisomsb}[1]{\; \smash{\mathop{\; \longleftarrow \; }\limits\sp{\sim}\limits\sb{#1}}\; }

\newcommand{\mapdown}{\phantom{\Big\downarrow}\hskip -8pt \downarrow}
\newcommand{\mapdownright}[1]{\mapdown\rlap{$\vcenter{\hbox{$\scriptstyle#1$}}$}}
\newcommand{\mapdownleft}[1]{\llap{$\vcenter{\hbox{$\scriptstyle#1$\;}}$}\mapdown}
\newcommand{\mapdownsurj}{
\hbox{$\downarrow$}
\llap{\hbox{\raise 2pt\hbox{$\downarrow$}}}%
%\vstrech %mapdown
}

\newcommand{\mapup}{\phantom{\Big\uparrow}\hskip -8pt \uparrow}
\newcommand{\mapupright}[1]{\mapup\rlap{$\vcenter{\hbox{$\scriptstyle#1$}}$}}
\newcommand{\mapupleft}[1]{\rlap{$\vcenter{\hbox{$\scriptstyle#1$}}$}%
\phantom{\Big\uparrow}\mapup}
\newcommand{\mapupsurj}{
\hbox{$\bigm\uparrow$}
\llap{\hbox{\raise 2pt\hbox{$\bigm\uparrow$}}}%
\vstrechmapup
}
